title: Shadowing and metric expansivity on Fréchet spaces
summary: We prove that (1) the weighted composition operator \(Tf(z)=c f(Bz)\) on the Fréchet space \(H(\mathbb{C}^d)\) of entire functions on \(\mathbb{C}^d\) (\(d\in\mathbb{N}\)) with the compact-open topology has the shadowing property whenever \(0<|c|<1\) and \(B\in\operatorname{GL}_d(\mathbb C)\) has spectral radius less than \(1\); (2) every bilateral weighted forward shift on \(\mathbb K^{\mathbb Z}\) with nonzero weights has the shadowing property; and (3) no continuous linear operator on a countably infinite product of nonzero finite-dimensional normed spaces is metrically positively…
